title: LaunchDarkly Feature Flag
description: A feature flag configuration in LaunchDarkly, including its variations, targeting rules, and environment-specific settings.

key.description: The unique key identifying this feature flag.

name.description: The human-readable name of the feature flag.

description.description: A description of the feature flag purpose and behavior.

kind.description: The type of flag, either boolean (two variations) or multivariate (multiple variations).

tags.description: Tags applied to this feature flag for organization and filtering.

creationDate.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the flag was created.

temporary.description: Whether this flag is intended to be temporary and should be cleaned up after use.

archived.description: Whether this flag has been archived and is no longer actively used.

includeInSnippet.description: Whether this flag is available to client-side SDKs.

clientSideAvailability.description: Controls which client-side SDKs can access this flag.

usingEnvironmentId.description: Whether this flag is available to client-side SDKs using the environment ID.

usingMobileKey.description: Whether this flag is available to mobile SDKs.

variations.description: The possible values this flag can serve.

defaults.description: Default variation settings applied when new environments are created.

onVariation.description: The index of the variation to serve when the flag is on.

offVariation.description: The index of the variation to serve when the flag is off.

environments.description: A map of environment keys to their flag configurations.

_version.description: The current version number of this flag for optimistic concurrency control.

Variation.description: A single variation value that a feature flag can serve.

_id.description: The unique identifier of this variation.

value.description: The value of this variation. Can be any JSON type including boolean, string, number, or object.

name.description: An optional human-readable name for this variation.

description.description: An optional description of what this variation represents.

FlagEnvironment.description: The configuration of a feature flag for a specific environment.

on.description: Whether the flag is currently enabled in this environment.

archived.description: Whether the flag is archived in this environment.

salt.description: The salt used for percentage rollout hashing.

lastModified.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds of the last modification.

version.description: The version number of this flag configuration in this environment.

targets.description: Individual context targets for each variation.

rules.description: Targeting rules that determine which variation to serve.

offVariation.description: The variation index to serve when the flag is off.

prerequisites.description: Flags that must be evaluated before this flag.

trackEvents.description: Whether to send detailed event data for this flag.

trackEventsFallthrough.description: Whether to send events for the fallthrough rule.

Target.description: An individual targeting entry that serves a specific variation to listed context keys.

values.description: The list of context keys targeted.

variation.description: The variation index to serve to these targets.

contextKind.description: The context kind for this target.

Rule.description: A targeting rule with clauses that must all match for the rule to apply.

_id.description: The unique identifier for this rule.

clauses.description: The conditions that must all be met for this rule to match.

variation.description: The variation index to serve when this rule matches.

trackEvents.description: Whether to track events for this rule.

Clause.description: A condition clause used in targeting rules.

negate.description: Whether to negate the clause result.

contextKind.description: The context kind to evaluate the attribute against.

Rollout.description: A percentage rollout distributing traffic across variations.

variations.description: The weighted variations in this rollout.

weight.description: The rollout weight in thousandths of a percent (0-100000).

bucketBy.description: The context attribute used for bucket assignment.

contextKind.description: The context kind for rollout bucketing.

VariationOrRollout.description: The default fallthrough rule specifying a variation or rollout.

Prerequisite.description: A prerequisite flag that must evaluate to a specific variation before this flag is evaluated.

key.description: The key of the prerequisite flag.

variation.description: The variation index that the prerequisite must serve.
